exposure: Maternal dose of buprenorphine at time of delivery
Maternal dose of methadone at time of delivery
outcome: Requirement for treatment of neonatal abstinence syndrome (NAS)
cohort: Mother-infant dyads, including 1251 control participants with a negative meconium drug screen and 228 participants whose mothers received opioid maintenance treatment (181 MMT, 47 BMT).
finding: Opioid maintenance treatment (OMT) was associated with lower neonatal birth weight and head circumference z-scores, and high maternal buprenorphine dosing specifically correlated with lower anthropometric z-scores, an effect not seen with methadone.
birth_weight: N/A (z-scores were analyzed, not absolute weights)
gest_age: Gestational age at delivery was slightly higher in the BMT group (p=0.05).
